articles.title: Nigeria to invest $460m W’Bank loan in fibre infrastructure

The project seeks to drastically improve Nigeria's digital connectivity, boosting economic growth and expanding internet access for its population.

articles.title: Preventive detention can't be to prolong custody: Supreme Court
articles.summary: The Supreme Court of India recently clarified that preventive detention cannot be used as a means to unlawfully prolong an individual's custody. This significant ruling emphasizes that preventive detention is intended for specific circumstances to prevent future offenses, not to extend existing confinement or circumvent regular legal procedures. This upholds constitutional safeguards against arbitrary deprivation of liberty, crucial for understanding legal frameworks.

articles.title: Maharashtra: Staffers skipping poll training will face criminal cases, warns Thane Municipal Corporation
articles.summary: The Thane Municipal Corporation in Maharashtra has issued a stern warning, stating that any staffers found skipping mandatory election training will face criminal cases. This decisive action underscores the seriousness authorities attach to ensuring full participation and compliance for the smooth conduct of upcoming electoral processes, reflecting a strong stance on civic responsibility and democratic procedures.
